launch_restriction: No merge, deployment, production migration, real wallet key, network signing or transfer authorized.
limitations: All identities, assets, addresses, payment evidence and provider transfers are synthetic.
Chain decoder checks explicitly supplied fixtures and ancestry; it is not an RPC/finality observer.
Lost HTTP responses and COMMIT acknowledgements are injected after real local/disposable commits; this does not establish behavior under every real network failure.
The native restore provider is an explicit no-network lookup stub; separate file-provider/process tests verify provider persistence.
Logical backup checksum detects inconsistency, not authenticity, latestness or administrator rewrites. Restored state remains paused; controlled production resume is not implemented.
Actual platform session adapters were not included in this tested source; follow-on work has separate evidence.
Existing marketplace term acceptance, eligibility, accounting completion, outbox and notifications remain unconnected.
Global serialization and full replay remain a development bridge, not a production throughput or availability design.
No custody provider/testnet account, real signing policy, fiat verification authority, operational rollout or independent professional security audit has been completed.
